components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The main route to selected work or another primary action.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-block; padding: 10px 20px; border: 1px solid var(--amber); border-radius: 3px; background: var(--amber); color: var(--bg-0); font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-decoration: none; transition: filter 160ms, box-shadow 160ms, transform 160ms; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.08); box-shadow: 0 8px 28px rgb(232 179 74 / 18%); transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--amber); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(0); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A restrained supporting action on the operational field.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-block; padding: 10px 20px; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong); border-radius: 3px; background: transparent; color: var(--fg-soft); font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-decoration: none; transition: color 160ms, border-color 160ms, transform 160ms; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: var(--amber); color: var(--fg); transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--amber); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform: translateY(0); }

components.name: Résumé Pill
components.description: A compact utility action for opening the résumé.
components.css: .ds-resume-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; padding: 4px 11px; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong); border-radius: 999px; background: transparent; color: var(--amber); font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 12px; text-decoration: none; transition: color 140ms, border-color 140ms; } .ds-resume-pill:hover { color: var(--fg); border-color: var(--amber); } .ds-resume-pill:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--amber); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-resume-pill:active { color: var(--amber); }

components.name: Focus Card
components.description: A compact translucent container for a professional focus area.
components.html:
SYSTEMS ENGINEERING

Reliable software explained through concrete decisions and evidence.
components.css: .ds-focus-card { padding: 19px 20px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 8px; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg-1) 78%, transparent); color: var(--fg-soft); backdrop-filter: blur(6px); font-family: var(--mono); transition: border-color 180ms, background 180ms, transform 180ms; } .ds-focus-card h3 { margin: 0 0 6px; color: var(--mint); font-size: 13px; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-focus-card p { margin: 0; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.7; } .ds-focus-card:hover { border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--amber) 42%, var(--line)); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg-1) 90%, transparent); transform: translateX(4px); } .ds-focus-card:focus-within { outline: 2px solid var(--amber); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Technology Tag
components.description: A quiet, non-interactive evidence label for a technology or discipline.
components.css: .ds-technology-tag { display: inline-block; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 2px; background: var(--bg-3); color: var(--fg-soft); font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 10.5px; line-height: 1.45; letter-spacing: 0.04em; }

components.name: Navigation Bar
components.description: The fixed operational header with an amber brand and active-link signal.
components.html:
thathsara.dev
workcontact
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding: 13px 28px; border-bottom: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--line) 72%, transparent); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg-0) 78%, transparent); color: var(--fg-mute); backdrop-filter: blur(16px) saturate(130%); font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 12px; } .ds-brand { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; color: var(--amber); font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.02em; text-decoration: none; } .ds-brand i { width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--mint); box-shadow: 0 0 8px var(--mint); } .ds-brand span { color: var(--fg-mute); font-weight: 400; } .ds-nav div { display: flex; gap: 18px; } .ds-nav-link { position: relative; padding: 5px 0; color: var(--fg-mute); text-decoration: none; transition: color 160ms; } .ds-nav-link::after { position: absolute; right: 0; bottom: 0; left: 0; height: 1px; background: var(--amber); content: ''; transform: scaleX(0); transform-origin: right; transition: transform 180ms ease; } .ds-nav-link:hover { color: var(--fg); } .ds-nav-link:hover::after, .ds-nav-link.active::after { transform: scaleX(1); transform-origin: left; } .ds-nav-link.active { color: var(--amber); } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--amber); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Contact Path
components.description: A full-width closing route that states both the action and its intent.
components.html: Start a conversationCollaborations and project enquiries↗
components.css: .ds-contact-path { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto; align-items: center; gap: 18px; padding: 16px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); color: var(--fg-soft); font-family: var(--mono); text-decoration: none; transition: color 160ms, border-color 160ms, padding 180ms; } .ds-contact-path span { font-size: 14px; color: var(--amber); } .ds-contact-path small { grid-column: 1; color: var(--fg-mute); font-size: 11px; } .ds-contact-path b { grid-column: 2; grid-row: 1 / 3; color: var(--amber); font-weight: 400; } .ds-contact-path:hover { color: var(--amber); border-color: var(--amber); padding-inline: 8px; } .ds-contact-path:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--amber); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-contact-path:active { padding-inline: 4px; }

narrative.overview:
The interface is a near-black working field where technical range becomes credible through inspectable artifacts. It feels precise, authored, and quietly cinematic: serif statements establish a human point of view, while monospaced evidence reads like field notes from systems that genuinely run.

Amber and mint behave as signals rather than decoration. Physical systems photography, the point-cloud portrait, restrained atmospheric light, and fine operational lines give the portfolio a memorable material presence without competing with comprehension. The system refuses the generic skills-grid portfolio; every expressive choice must help visitors follow the wire from artifact to outcome.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black operational surfaces with fine slate structure.
Instrument Serif statements paired with JetBrains Mono evidence.
Rare amber emphasis and mint status signals.
Flat, layered panels with restrained glow only where state or artifact demands it.
Physical and browser-rendered artifacts used as proof, not decoration.

rules.name: The Signal Rarity Rule
rules.body: Amber directs attention and mint reports status; neither becomes a general-purpose fill or decorative wash.

rules.name: The Statement-and-Evidence Rule
rules.body: Serif type makes the claim; monospaced type explains, labels, and substantiates it.

rules.name: The Flat-by-Default Rule
rules.body: Resting surfaces use tone and line; glow appears only for live state, interactive lift, or an artifact that needs separation.

dos: Do use concrete artifacts, system diagrams, and physical photography as evidence.
Do preserve the serif-statement and mono-evidence relationship.
Do keep amber for direction and mint for status.
Do express hierarchy with spacing, tone, and one-pixel structure before adding shadow.
Do provide static fallbacks and reduced-motion behavior for signature effects.
donts: Don't replace proof with a generic skills grid or decorative technology cloud.
Don't turn accent colors into broad ornamental fills.
Don't soften the system with oversized radii, pill-shaped cards, or inflated controls.
Don't add persistent glow or shadow to ordinary resting surfaces.
Don't let the point-cloud portrait become a prerequisite for reading, navigation, or contact.
